deities: Sri Raja Rajeshwara Swamy (Neelalohitha Shiva Linga)

history.summary: The famous Rajanna temple of Vemulawada, called Dakshina Kashi. Vemulawada was the capital of the Vemulawada Chalukyas (750-973 CE); the present temple is attributed to Rajadithya, a governor of the Kalyani Chalukyas, between the 11th and 12th centuries (DATE CONFLICT: other sources date construction to the 9th century Chalukya era; one devotional source credits King Raja Narendra - verify). The Neelalohitha Shiva Linga is said to have been found in the Dharma Gundam tank; the complex is a Harihara Kshetram with both Shaiva and Vaishnava shrines, and a Muslim saint's tomb/dargah within the complex. Major state-led renovation and expansion underway since 2025 (verify status before visiting).

name: Sri Raja Rajeshwara Swamy Temple
town_description: Vemulawada, in Rajanna Sircilla district, is one of Telangana's foremost pilgrimage towns - once the Chalukya capital, now dominated by the Rajanna temple with satellite shrines (Bheemeshwara, Baddi Pochamma, Nampally Gutta) around it.
tradition: Shaivite (Smartha Agama; Pancharatra Agama in the Vishnu shrines - Harihara Kshetram)

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad (approx 185 km)
travel.road: On the Karimnagar-Kamareddy route; frequent TSRTC buses from Hyderabad, Secunderabad, Warangal and Karimnagar; approx 150 km from Hyderabad

visitor_information.best_time: Maha Shivaratri; Sravana Masam and Karthika Masam draw the biggest crowds
visitor_information.opening_hours: 4:00 AM - 9:00 PM (darshan from 4:35 AM; arjitha sevas through the day)
